title: What is a speedrun?
text: A speedrun is a special way to play a video game. The goal is very simple: you finish the game as fast as you can. A person who does speedruns is a speedrunner.
Speedrunners can finish some games in a few minutes. A normal player needs many hours. How can they do it? They know every level, every enemy and every secret.
A speedrunner can play the same game every day for months. They can practice one small jump a thousand times. They cannot make mistakes: one second is very important!
When a speedrunner finishes a game, they send a video to a website. On the website you can see the best times in the world. Can you see your name there?
There are also big events for speedrunners. They play in front of many people and the money goes to charities. Speedrunning can help people!
q: What is the goal of a speedrun?
To finish the game as fast as you can

grammar.title: Grammar: can and cannot
grammar.rule: Use can for ability. It is the same for all people, and the next verb has no to. Negative: cannot.

es.title: ¿Qué es un speedrun?
es.sub: Terminar un juego lo más rápido posible
es.grammar: Gramática: can (poder, saber hacer). Es igual para todas las personas y el verbo que sigue va sin to. Negativo: cannot.
